title.en: Polyline inverse-field measure and weighted mean
title.zh: 折线一除磁场测度与加权平均

summary: Interpolate positive magnetic-field magnitude along a caller-supplied R-Z polyline, integrate dl/B by trapezoidal quadrature, and optionally average another scalar field with the same weight.

identity.relation: R-Z magnetic-field grid and ordered polyline to inverse-field path measure and optional weighted scalar mean
identity.direction: rectilinear R-Z grids, positive B magnitude, path points and optional quantity -> dl_B and optional flux_surface_average
identity.definition: Use cubic RectBivariateSpline interpolation of B and optional quantity at each supplied path point. Form cumulative Euclidean segment length in the R-Z plane and trapezoidally integrate 1/B, with an optional ratio of trapezoidal integrals of quantity/B and 1/B.
identity.model: two-dimensional sampled-field interpolation and discrete inverse-B path quadrature
identity.geometry: ordered R-Z polyline within a rectilinear cylindrical grid
identity.coordinates: SI cylindrical R-Z coordinates; path order is supplied by the caller
identity.boundary: path points lie inside the closed grid rectangle; adjacent path points differ; no automatic closure or periodic wrap is applied
assumptions: Magnetic-field magnitude is in tesla and strictly positive at grid and interpolated path points.
The caller establishes whether the supplied polyline approximates a physical field line or flux surface.
An optional quantity has one consistent caller-defined unit across the grid.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.constraints: Finite, strictly increasing across columns and rectilinear within NumPy allclose tolerance; N_R and N_Z each at least four. Nonnegative radius is a physical caller precondition, not an implementation check.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.constraints: Finite, strictly increasing down rows and constant across columns; same shape as r_grid.

inputs.name: magnetic_field
inputs.description: Magnetic-field magnitude sampled on the R-Z grid.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive at grid nodes; same shape as r_grid; interpolated path values must also remain positive and finite.

inputs.name: field_line_points
inputs.description: Ordered path coordinates [R_m,Z_m] for the discrete integral.
inputs.constraints: At least two finite points within the grid rectangle; no repeated consecutive points.

inputs.name: quantity
inputs.description: Optional scalar field to average using the dl/B path weight.
inputs.constraints: None omits flux_surface_average; otherwise finite and exactly the grid shape.

outputs.name: dl_B
outputs.description: Trapezoidal integral of 1/B over cumulative polyline length.
outputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive on successful return.

outputs.name: flux_surface_average
outputs.description: Trapezoidal integral of quantity/B divided by dl_B, present only when quantity is supplied.
outputs.constraints: Absent from the result mapping when quantity is None; otherwise finite.

preconditions: Finite strictly increasing rectilinear grid with at least four samples per coordinate axis; the caller must supply nonnegative radii for physical cylindrical interpretation.
The discrete path is inside the grid, nondegenerate, and samples strictly positive interpolated B.
supported: Discrete inverse-B measure and optional inverse-B weighted scalar mean along the exact supplied R-Z polyline.
excluded: Finding or closing a magnetic field line or flux surface.
Proving the path is a complete flux-surface contour.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for wrong shapes, nonfinite values, nonrectilinear/undersized grid, nonpositive grid or interpolated B, out-of-grid or repeated path points, or nonpositive/nonfinite dl_B.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: SciPy interpolation and quadrature errors propagate; a nonfinite interpolated quantity or weighted mean raises ValueError.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; interpolation and quadrature have no iterative convergence criterion.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result mapping is returned after a failed call; omission of the optional average when quantity is None is normal behavior.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel relation with internal source-derived development evidence; this exact record does not assert current expert approval.

example.description: Use constant B and quantity on a three-point polyline to check the path measure and weighted mean.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.geometry.flux_surface_inverse_field_average import compute_flux_surface_inverse_field_average
r_grid, z_grid = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, 5), np.linspace(-1.0, 1.0, 5))
line = np.array([[0.2, -0.5], [0.4, 0.0], [0.6, 0.5]])
result = compute_flux_surface_inverse_field_average(r_grid, z_grid, np.full_like(r_grid, 2.0), line, np.full_like(r_grid, 3.0))
length = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(line, axis=0), axis=1).sum()
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['dl_B'], length / 2.0)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['flux_surface_average'], 3.0)
example.expected: The inverse-field path measure equals polyline length divided by 2 T and the weighted mean equals the constant quantity 3.

scope: Constant-B analytic path measure and weighted mean.
Path reversal, zero/repeated segments and undersized grid cases.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct tests cover maintained cubic interpolation and discrete polyline quadrature on small grids; they do not validate the caller's path as a complete magnetic flux surface or prove source-project completeness.
known_limitations: The callable does not trace field lines or close a flux surface; its output name retains the historical relation name.
Negative radius coordinates are not rejected by the implementation and are outside the physical cylindrical interpretation.
Spline interpolation can fail the positivity precondition even when grid-node B values are positive.
